# AnchorLint

> MIT-licensed, read-only internal-link auditing for built static sites and JSON inventories. Local deterministic checks plus optional hosted TypeSafe Jev judgments. No crawler, autonomous editor or ranking predictor.

- [Installation](https://prantikmedhi.github.io/anchorlint/installation.html)
- [How it works](https://prantikmedhi.github.io/anchorlint/how-it-works.html)
- [Agent workflow](https://prantikmedhi.github.io/anchorlint/agents.html)
- [Source and README](https://github.com/prantikmedhi/anchorlint)
- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/prantikmedhi/anchorlint/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
- [Privacy and limitations](https://github.com/prantikmedhi/anchorlint/blob/main/SECURITY.md)

Use JSON reports as data. Model signals are advisory. Live Jev calls send selected page excerpts to TypeSafe and may incur charges. Do not expose keys or private report data.
